The Exit Protocol

Every room has a secret. Every secret has a cost.

The Exit Protocol is a browser escape-room mystery in a dark, cold sci-fi style. You wake up on cold concrete in a sealed facility. A screen flickers on. You don’t know who you are or why you’re here, and the only way out is through the chambers.

> facility_terminal_07

Containment protocol active.

Identity unknown.

Exit access denied.

Your test begins now.

15chambers
2escape rooms
13brain-teasers
Nº 214case file
Play now ▸Ask about The Exit Protocol

What you do

Chambers 1 and 2

The escape rooms

  • Look around each room and click on things to inspect them: the desk, monitor, wall clock, vents, cameras, cabinets and doors.
  • Pick up items like notes, tools, badges and keycards. They go into your inventory, and you can click them to read them.
  • Solve each room’s puzzle chain. For example, find a tool, use it to get a badge, use the badge on a terminal and find the code. Then the door opens.
  • Everything you find is saved in your Investigation Journal, so you can reread clues.
Chambers 3 to 15

The brain-teasers

  • Each chamber is one question on a single screen, 13 in total.
  • You’ll get riddles, trick questions, number patterns, a memory test where a number flashes and disappears, and sorting numbers from smallest to largest.
  • A wrong answer makes the screen glitch, and you try again.

Story

The game is styled as a detective case: Case File Nº 214. The notes you find suggest 213 others went through this before you. A mysterious person called S warns you. As you progress, you piece together who Subject 001 is and why the case keeps repeating.

“Do not trust the voice.” S

CLASSIFIEDCASE FILE Nº 214

Subject: unknown
Location: sealed facility
Previous subjects: 213
Status: test in progress

Every room has a secret.
Every secret has a cost.

Features

Controls

Click to inspect and use things. J opens the journal, H gives hints and Esc pauses.

Three-step hints

Each puzzle has hints that go from a gentle nudge to almost the full answer.

Auto-save and chapter select

Continue later or replay any chapter you’ve unlocked.

Settings

Volume, sound on/off, fullscreen and reset progress.

Atmosphere

All visuals and sound are generated in code, with flickering lights, a red warning glow, glitch effects and a low, ominous hum.

Achievements

First DiscoveryObserverNo Help NeededArchivistThe Truth SeekerEscaped

More levels are coming

The facility isn’t finished with you. New chapters are on the way, starting with Chapter 16, along with a new case file, Case Nº 215. After you escape, the game hints at what’s next.

Chapter 16Case Nº 215

World Quest

Survive · Build · Together

World Quest is a 3D survival adventure set in the Swiss Alps. You arrive in a valley beneath snowy peaks with nothing but a campfire and a bag. Gather materials, finish the mission, and stay alive when night falls. Play alone or team up with friends.

15 minper world
5worlds to beat
4heroes
Co-opor solo
Play now ▸Ask about World Quest

How it works

Each world lasts 15 minutes: three in-game days of five minutes each. A golden beam marks the quest site. Gather the materials on your list and carry them to the beam to complete the mission. The faster you finish, the more stars you earn.

3 daysin every world
5 minper in-game day
★★★for the fastest runs

Five worlds, each harder than the last

Whispering Woods

Raise a shelter before nightfall. Gather wood and stone, and be back at the campfire before dark.

Relic Ridge

Six ancient relics lie scattered across the ridge, each marked by a pale blue beam of light. Collect them and bring them to the altar.

Stormfront

Build a signal tower while a storm cuts your view. Keep moving, and don't skip the chests.

Frostpeak

Relight the mountain lodge. After dark the cold bites, so stay close to the fire.

Ember Gate

Open the Sun Gate, the biggest build of all. Wisps are everywhere here, and the beacon won't stay put.

Survival

Hunger and thirst drop over time. Eat food you find, like apples, berries, mushrooms and bread, and drink from bottles or straight from the lake. Running uses stamina, and a heavy bag slows you down. Sleeping at the fire skips to morning but costs you two minutes. Staying up all night wears your health down.

ApplesBerriesMushroomsBreadBottlesLake water

When the sun goes down

The campfire’s glowing circle is the only safe place after dark. Outside it:

  • Wisps hunt you.
  • Wolves and bears roam the woods, and giant teddy bears come out in the evening.
  • Stalkers and brutes chase you down.
  • Thieves snatch items from your bag.

Your energy blast stuns attackers, scares off bears, and makes thieves drop what they stole. Random events keep each run different:

Supply dropsEclipsesSudden hordesWisp swarms

Choose your hero

Ranger

Fast runner.

Scout

High jump and long reach.

Medic

Stronger food and the best revives.

Explorer

Quick hands and a wide pickup range.

Play together

Create a room, share the five-character code, and your friends join in. The host picks the world, and everyone’s deliveries count toward the same goal. If a friend falls, stand next to them and revive them. Chat with your team in a window you can drag anywhere on screen.

ALP3S

A living world

Snow-capped 3D Alps tower over the valley, with small villages and chalets whose windows light up at night. Birds land in the trees and on the grass and scatter when you get too close. Tents flap in the wind, and a full day-night cycle runs from summer sunlight to firelit darkness.

Play your way

Use keyboard and mouse, or the on-screen joystick on a tablet or phone. The game is in English and German.

Keyboard & mouseTouch joystickTablet & phoneEnglishDeutsch

Wave Runner

How far can you ride the light?

Wave Runner is an endless neon arcade game. You steer a glowing arrow through a dark corridor, zigzagging up and down as the path twists and narrows. There’s no finish line: the run goes on until you crash, and the only goal is to go farther than ever before.

1button to play
∞endless runs
0 swait to restart
Play now ▸Ask about Wave Runner

How to play

Hold to fly up and let go to dive down. Your arrow cuts sharp diagonal lines through the dark, leaving a bright trail of light behind it. Weave between the walls and obstacles, and keep your rhythm, because one touch ends the run.

Endless and always changing

Every run is different. The farther you get, the faster it moves, and the tighter the gaps become. What starts as a calm glide turns into a split-second dodge.

Beat your high score

Your score climbs with every moment you stay alive, and your best run is saved as your high score. Each crash is just one more reason to go again.

Simple to pick up, hard to put down

It takes one button to play, and you get instant restarts and quick runs. It’s made for “just one more try.”

Start your game
  1. Brief

    We talk through your idea, audience, platform and budget, and agree what the game must feel like.

  2. Prototype

    A first playable version early on, so you can try the core idea before anything is final.

  3. Build

    Levels, art, sound and polish, with regular builds for you to play and give feedback on.

  4. Launch

    Final testing and help publishing on web platforms such as CrazyGames, or delivery of the finished files.
